physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual per-frame review in the unchanged 1774x887 4x2 source boards after complete-source ownership recovery. The landmark is the visible pelvis/posterior hip at the sacral tail root, never the tail tip, skull, reaching claw or global bounding-box centre. Anchor x is that landmark's vertical projection. Anchor y equals the complete recovered sourceBounds bottom, including the full three-pixel extraction guard below the lowest load-bearing foot, knee, hand, forearm, flank or airborne extremity. All seven short cross-cell transfers remain pixel-identical and only establish source ownership.
